cards.title: Fleet view — one page over every onboarded board

note.text: The deferred half of SW-033. With per-repo trackers, Alberto_s choose-a-folder wish becomes: point the desk at ~/projects, scan depth-2 for .shipward/tracker.json, and render a fleet index — one row per project with its in-flight count, waiting count, last feed line and a link into that repo_s board. Deliberately NOT built with SW-033: serving N trackers from one process means per-tracker etags and PUT routing (/api/tracker is hardcoded today), and the single-repo flow had to prove itself first. DP-001 in the demo repo is that proof. Build this when two or more real projects are actually onboarded and switching between desks becomes the felt pain — let the failure pick the feature.
